title: Cheetos® unveils Sweet Phantom Heat™ Flavored Puffs, a first-of-its-kind multi-sensory Halloween snack experience
summary: Inspired by compounds found in Sichuan pepper, the new flavor combines sweetness, heat, tingling and a subtle fizz. Learn more about new Cheetos® Sweet Phantom Heat Flavored Puffs™, a first-of-its-kind multi-sensory Halloween snack experience.
body_markdown:
Over the years, Halloween has served as a platform for Cheetos to bring fans limited-edition flavors, immersive experiences and unexpected twists, offering a savory alternative during a holiday often associated with sweets.


Cheetos Sweet Phantom Heat Puffs will be available at retailers nationwide and on[TikTok Shop](https://www.tiktok.com/@fritolay.shop) beginning Aug. 31.


**Frequently asked questions**


**What causes the tingling or numbing sensation?**


Some of these sensations are inspired by compounds found in Sichuan pepper, which are known to interact with sensory nerves in the mouth and create the distinctive tingling and numbing experience.


**How long does the sensorial effect last?**


Like any flavor experience, the sensorial experience can vary from person to person and can last from several minutes to up to 30 minutes after last consumed.


**Does the sensorial experience get stronger the more you eat?**


Yes, the heat, tingle and numbing sensations all intensify with subsequent bites, building a layered flavor journey throughout the snacking experience.


**Does the product contain artificial colors or flavors?**


No, Cheetos Sweet Phantom Heat Puffs do not contain any artificial colors or flavors.


**What natural colors or ingredients are used in the product?**


Cheetos Sweet Phantom Heat is colored using red radish juice and Paprika Extract.
